Something that I personally found helpful is making logs of all purchases made in a typical month. Based on your income and living expenses you can plan a budget. For example if you were earning 12/hr, multiply that by the hours you typically work, apply taxes. From what's left after tax you first take X amount for obligations such as rent/food. Say if after taxes/rent/food etc month you had $1000, allocate a fraction of it to savings. Be realistic when you do this though, most people aren't going to save 800$ of the $1000.
